meta.title: ci: add rust cache to turbo test workflow
meta.body_summary: Add Swatinem/rust-cache@v2 to turbo test CI workflow for faster Rust compilation caching, with small follow-up cleanups.

perf_labels.notes: Devin added Rust caching across two CI workflows; maintainer CHANGES_REQUESTED removing self-references; after fix, PR merged quickly. No benchmark evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At just 15 changed lines across 2 workflow files, this is a tiny CI configuration edit. It fits a minimal, low-risk performance PR that was merged quickly after one round of review.

review_details.concern_detail: cprussin CHANGES_REQUESTED: "Pleas remove the self-references in the files section in each action as thy are not necessary" (typo in original).
review_details.performance_claim: Add Rust caching to improve CI build times.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: prior_missing_cache (not in taxonomy; prior CI ran without Rust cache)

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Simple CI workflow addition required adherence to maintainer's style preference for no self-references; the agent quickly fixed the minor flaw.

detection_detail.code_reading: cprussin reviewed the workflow files and requested removal of self-references.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after CI timing data; only a narrative performance claim.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: After CHANGES_REQUESTED, Devin removed self-references in commit 520e57; PR was then approved and merged.

core_change_summary.description: Added Swatinem/rust-cache@v2 step to ci-turbo-test.yml and ci-turbo-build.yml, then removed self-references in workflow path triggers after review.
change_trajectory: Initial commit added rust cache to test workflow only.
Second commit added cache to build workflow and added workflow triggers.
Jayantk manually removed some triggers (commit d9d7c3).
Devin removed self-references as requested in review (commit 520e57).

review_signals.summary: Requested removal of self-references from workflow files.
Devin bot announced automatic comment/CI monitoring capability.
Vercel deployment preview posted; unrelated to CI performance.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened with rust cache for test workflow only.
Devin extended caching to build workflow and added extra path triggers.
cprussin requested removal of self-references about 1.8h after PR creation.
Devin fixed the self-references within ~10 minutes; cprussin approved and merged ~2h total.
